response.body:
## Purpose and current contract
Publish the Orchestra visual migration plan, execution tools and the executor-requested design complement. This is the planning/publication portion of #215: **it does not close the visual epic or mark any product task complete**.

Product contract is now **4.4**, retaining the same 4 subepics, 10 issues, 25 subissues, 38 work packages and 66 tasks. Existing scopes, dependency graph, leases, performance budgets and criterion IDs are preserved. The five axiom groups are explicit at every level and now bind the applicable supplemental design decisions.

## Start here — exact locations
All paths are relative to `specs/orchestra-visual/` on this branch.

- `RUN.md`: doctor → resume → packet for the selected task; `START-HERE.md` is the longer guide.
- `design/REQUESTS.md`: item-by-item response to A1–A11, B1–B10 and all six C1 requests. `REQUESTS-SOURCE.md` preserves the received text.
- `design/EXECUTOR-DECISIONS.md`: optical alignment, Q01–Q16, state behavior, V1/V2 compatibility, iconography, RTL, compact sidebar, native integration, measurement procedure and truthful capability states.
- `design/README.md` and `design/ASSETS.json`: assets, intended consumers, provenance and destinations.
- `design/reference.html`, `reference.css`, `reference.js`: new editable reference source; `design/gallery.html` is a local viewer, not a GitHub-hosted live page.
- `design/states/`: 22 actual UI design references at 1672×941 plus the native 1152×768 compact view. `design/elements/`: 19 isolated element references. These are not implementation screenshots.
- `design/zen/`: reusable scoped CSS, tokens, token bindings and measured color samples. Only explicitly sampled roles are labeled measured; other values are engineering decisions.
- `design/icons/`: 33 exports from the existing 16/20-viewBox sprite, no new icon dependency. Runtime integration reuses the existing Icon component.
- `design/landscape/`: clean WebP/PNG, mask and provenance; reconstructed hidden sky is disclosed. `design/brand/`: supplied official symbol variants, unchanged.
- `copy.json`: 113 PT-BR/EN keys with context and placeholders for the existing S22 owner.
- `WIDGETS.md`: nine widget contracts and 28 product scenarios; `PLAN.json`, `issues/` and `INDEX.md`: execution units and their five axioms.

The two earlier generated images containing a textual response are not specifications and were not included in this package.

## Design decisions, not open choices delegated to the executor
No original Figma was supplied; the HTML/CSS is an explicitly new reconstruction. The original user-approved `reference/approved.png` remains intact and remains the primary visual authority. Supplemental DS states are planner-defined direction, not falsely labeled as new user approvals.

Use the existing icon family and repository fonts. Preserve the existing light palette while implementing the required functional surfaces. Compact sidebar is 56 px with specified labels/tooltips/hitboxes and no landscape. RTL mirrors application composition but not the logo, landscape, code, URLs, signed counts, shortcuts, timestamps or OS-native window-control placement. Theme primitives remain opt-in through existing providers. Native integration reuses current IPC/controllers; an omitted supported integration cannot be hidden behind `unavailable`.

S01 still requires a real classified census. S02 still implements real fixture/collectors. External Own/Maestro live capabilities remain gated; no foreign issues are closed to manufacture authority. The isolated-worktree procedure preserves the executor's existing janitor checkout and untracked work. No user-machine changes are claimed.

## Executed verification and publication
[Design publication](https://github.com/gmhelmold/HuGR-Orchestra/actions/runs/36371915619) rendered the references, passed **296 tooling tests (280 retained + 16 new)**, regenerated/checked projections, generated all 66 task packets, verified protected inputs and reconciled all 39 subordinate ticket bodies plus root #215. Native hierarchy/dependencies required no changes. Publication and exact identities are recorded in `reviews/design-complement/PUBLICATION.json` and `VERIFICATION.json`.

[Final reference inspection and verification](https://github.com/gmhelmold/HuGR-Orchestra/actions/runs/36372888046) repeated the 296 tests and **23 reference-DOM boundary checks**, correcting compact URL overflow, RTL-native-control placement, LTR logs/signed data, accessible names and explicit dialog-width exceptions. `reviews/design-complement/REFERENCE-REVIEW.json` records findings, checks and limitations. This is same-assistant inspection, not an independent external audit or a beauty score.

No font files are added to the design bundle. Authoring dependencies are isolated from product packages. Temporary publication workflows have been removed; the existing scoped, read-only `.github/workflows/orchestra-plan.yml` now also validates design inputs.

## Previous adversarial repairs retained
EX-01 normalizes and protects the census universe. EX-02 unifies candidate submission freshness with the selector; integrity-only is not approval. EX-03 binds ancestor axiom application/stages. H-01 rejects explicitly fabricated/test-only evidence at product submission without forbidding real measurements over synthetic workloads. E-01 uses controlled contract freeze, not a new invalidation engine. Details: `reviews/full-execution-audit/repairs/`.

Atlas provenance/formatter ownership was resolved separately in merged #234 after its ordinary checks. No guards, source facts or runtime architecture were weakened here.

## Axioms and merge boundary
**DoD:** requested design inputs and decisions are present and traceable, tooling/projection checks pass, published tickets agree, and ordinary PR checks pass on the current candidate before merge.
**Invariants:** approved master and brand remain intact; no product PASS, invented provenance, broad ownership changes, overwritten user work or CI bypass.
**Quality standards:** editable sources, explicit measured-versus-chosen values, executable bounded checks, honest reference/product distinction and precise artifact locations.
**Completeness criteria:** A1–A11, B1–B10 and C1.1–C1.6 mapped; 22 states, compact/RTL references, icons/landscape/copy, existing widgets, native/performance protocols and safe workspace entry covered.
**Success criteria:** the executor can implement the existing graph without inventing missing design decisions or depending on chat ZIPs.

**No Orchestra frontend build, Electron runtime verification, user-Mac calibration or interface benchmark is claimed by the reference renders.** Ordinary checks must be evaluated on this candidate; previous green runs do not approve a newer revision. No automatic merge.
response.title: docs(app): publish Orchestra visual contracts and executor design inputs
